filler2scents.intro: You briefly stop to smell the air, two diverging scents reaching your nose. Interesting.

Follow the sweet scent: Initiates claiming a New Befriended Wolf

conditional.Follow the sweet scent: Befriending is not available if your territory is full.

fillerbirdrest.intro: You hear the faint twitter of birds somewhere nearby. You look up to the sky and watch them swooping overhead. What would it feel like to fly? You find a nice comfortable spot in the shade and rest for a moment.

fillerbutterfly.intro: Catching your breath, a small butterfly lands on your nose.

Chomp: +1 random recipe from butterfly pool*//+1% hunger

notes: *Blinded Sphinx|imgrecipeanimal;imgblindedsphynx, Brown Longtail|imgrecipeanimal;imgbrownlongtail, Canyon Rubyspot|imgrecipeanimal;imgcanyonrubyspot, Diana Fritillary|imgrecipeanimal;imgdianafritillary, Fiery Skipper|imgrecipeanimal;imgfieryskipper, Giant Swallowtail|imgrecipeanimal;imggiantswallowtail, Gulf Fritillary|imgrecipeanimal;imggulffritillary, Uhler's Arctic|imgrecipeanimal;imguhlersarctic, White Peacock|imgrecipeanimal;imgwhitepeacock

fillercritters.intro: You see some small critters running desperately in the opposite direction.

Keep Moving Forward: Automatic battle with level (LVL+5) local enemy @location1

fillerdirtsnuffle.intro: You snuffle around in the dirt. It's here somewhere.. Yes! Jackpot!

fillerscentpath.intro: You catch a strange scent on the ground, a mingling of two different scents. You follow them until they part ways.

Follow West: +1 random meat chunks item**//+1 random cave-building material***

fillerwaterpool.intro: A small pool of water appears up ahead, and as you approach you notice that there is a dim blue light glowing from beneath the surface of the water.

herbs.intro: You wander across some interesting plants growing from the soil. You give them a sniff.. oooh, herbs!

poop.intro: You come across some poop... Normally, you'd roll all over it, but for some reason, something seems special about this poop.

egg.intro: You stop in your tracks - a very vulgar wolf is passing by, vandalizing the bird nests in the vicinity. Oh no, the eggs!

tala.intro: Oh no! It's Tala! She seems to be taunting you for a little payback after the last fight. Are you brave enough to wrestle her?

Attack!: Automatic battle with enemy Wandering Tala

wolf.intro: A figure appears up ahead of you, you raise your nose to the air and sniff.. another wolf!

Befriend: Initiates claiming a New Befriended Wolf

deadcow.intro: A familiar scent reaches your nose before you can see its source. You see a large, dead cow. It's still very fresh and looks as if it only died moments ago.

cougarmom.intro: You stopped in mid-step upon noticing a large cougar on your path. And it wasn't alone. A young cub was attempting to keep pace with its mother as fast as it could with its short legs and still a bit wobbly movement. It’s a cute scenery but the cougar doesn't appear particularly thrilled by your presence.

aggressivegoldeneagle.intro: A peculiar sound caught your attention. You rarely hear something like this and your curiosity is stronger than your common sense. What you stumbled upon is no ordinary eagle's nest. While you've encountered them in the past, they are usually empty. However, this time is different – you spotted the white fluff of eagle chicks, checking you from the distance.

faultysteelwolftrap.intro: Suddenly, an intense pain spreads throughout your body, something feels as if it grabbed your leg suddenly, but you can pull it out gently. One of your legs was scraped by something metallic!

swarmingrats.intro: Individually, a single rat may make for a satisfying snack, but a bunch of them can turn into a feast no worse than much larger prey. The way they try to escape triggers your hunter instincts even more.

albinoravenmerchant.intro: A beautiful albino raven merchant has set up shop among some roots. You both look curiously at each other.

americancrowbuyer.intro: With a flutter of wings, you are accosted by an American crow with the most unique looking pouch. It seeks to trade things, but when you ask where the wares are, it expresses they are well hidden, very, very high. Fine then, keep your secrets.

americancrowseller.intro: You find a spot where an adorable American crow is selling shiny things. You don't have your silver cones with you, but maybe you can offer something more specific?

conditional.Give Shoe: This result can give ANY recipe.

americancrowtrader.intro: A big American crow with a curious-looking pouch lands in front of you, asking if you have cool items to trade. Let's see...

chihuahuanravenmerchant.intro: You excitedly trot towards the chihuahuan raven merchant, asking what's in store today. The raven seeks special items and wonders if you have any.

commonravenmerchant.intro: A low croak from above catches your attention. A big common raven merchant is seeking some items to refill its stock.

crowsnakeskinpurveyor.intro: What a fancy crow! It shows off its latest purchases, obviously fascinated by all types of shed snake skins. Maybe you have some for trade?

fishcrowmerchant.intro: On a rotten trunk among the tall trees, a fish crow croaks at you, inviting you to check out its wares. Looks like there's a high demand for certain items.

leucisticravenmerchant.intro: Your eyes water in awe when checking out all the pretty wares this leucistic raven merchant has in store. You ask if it's looking for anything to trade, but it's hard to hide your delight. The prices might be high!

piedravenpeddler.intro: Whoah! A magnificent pied raven peddler is inviting you to check out the fresh stock in their shop. You're more interested in its feathers at first, but soon enough you learn what the bird is interested in.

ravenantlerpurveyor.intro: You notice a big raven showing off its antler collection. It's looking for more. Maybe you have something to offer?

ravenbeakdealer.intro: When you spot a raven with a broken beak, you worry if it's able to feed properly, but you discover it has its own shop dedicated to beaks, and a few helpers moving things around. Looks like no matter what, it's making the best of its situation! Maybe it's looking to expand the collection?

ravenhoofdealer.intro: Fascinated by legs in many shapes and colours, this raven dealer seems to be eager to enhance their collection. You notice its white eye, but it seems to be watching your behaviour with a proper judgemental expression.

ravenshelldealer.intro: Stashed in all the nooks and crannies of an old, wiggly tree, are beautiful shells of all colours and sizes. The owner of the shop asks if you have anything cool to trade.

sinaloacrowmerchant.intro: You haven't seen anything like this before - a sinaloa crow merchant is carrying all the goods in a human-made basket. It all smells like delicious food, and even the fake tiny human smells fun. You have seen those before! Maybe it's looking for more?

easterncrowhawker.intro: The loud croaking of this eastern crow hawker announces the gathering of raven traders nearby.

floridacrowhawker.intro: At first you are annoyed by the croaking, but once you listen carefully, you manage to make out that the Florida crow hawker is directing animals to the nearest crow merchant.

northwesterncrowhawker.intro: A small, Northwestern Crow Hawker is announcing arrival of raven traders in the area.

southerncrowhawker.intro: You spot a southern crow hawker high in the sky as it announces a gathering of merchants just down by the river.

tamaulipascrowhawker.intro: You jump, surprised by the loud croaking of a tamaulipas crow hawker. Looks like new merchants are moving in somewhere near your den.

westerncrowhawker.intro: Here ye, here ye! The big raven market is opening nearby! This western crow hawker is busy announcing the location of new traders to all local animals.

barnowl.intro: A barn owl swoops overhead, clutching something in its talons. Maybe something tasty?

beaver.intro: A beaver appears startled at your sudden appearance, it seems to be in the middle of collecting materials.

Growl: +1 random recipe from cave-building material pool*
+1 random recipe from rare jay pool**

bluejay.intro: A blue jay is aggressively chasing and screaming at another bird - presumably one that got too close to its nest. In the chaos, you notice something fall to the ground in front of you.

cottontail.intro: A small fluffy bunny sits alert in the grass.

easternchipmunk.intro: An eastern chipmunk is perched upon the tree trunk, gingerly washing itself. As it notices you it leaps from the trunk and scurries off.

gartersnake.intro: This charming little snake slithers around in the grass and over the top of a large rock to peek from higher ground. It seems to be looking for something.
details: Unless you have an active item quest with the questing snake, this option will always have no reward.

leastweasel.intro: You spot this small least weasel standing on a rock. How cute!

ninebandedarmadillo.intro: A small Nine-Banded Armadillo sits cleaning itself before turning and trotting off.

opossum.intro: You spot an opossum on a tree branch above. It watches you closely, wary.

peregrinefalcon.intro: A Peregrine Falcon soars overhead, it's impossibly fast, you almost don't notice it. You watch as something drops from it.

raccoon.intro: This angry Raccoon seems to be guarding something. Hmmm...

raven.intro: A raven swoops down over your head and seems to be trying to get your attention.

Follow: +1 random item from raven feather pool*
+1 random recipe from rare jay pool*****

redsquirrel.intro: A red squirrel is perched on a branch, clasping what looks like a pinecone in its paws. It would be a shame if it dropped it...

southernflyingsquirrel.intro: You notice a small critter flying through the air.. what on earth? You take a closer look - seems to be a Southern Flying Squirrel!

stripedskunk.intro: This looks like an interesting, perhaps tasty creature... On second thought, it smells bad. Very very bad. Rancid, even. Time to run away!

wildturkey.intro: This tom turkey is strutting and making drumming noises. Perhaps there are some females nearby he is trying to impress.

disturbeddirt.intro: Hmm...the dirt has been displaced here, almost like someone was digging recently. Maybe something valuable is buried?

nearbycreeksound.intro: The familiar sound of a creek bubbling in the distance draws your pawsteps in that direction. It would be a nice spot to take a breather.

recentearthquakeshiftedground.intro: The ground has shifted due to the recent earthquake, making it much less stable to walk on. However, you hope that all the cracks and holes are full of hidden treasures that would otherwise have remained underground.

rockslidesounds.intro: Your ears catch the sound of rocks crashing down a slope nearby. You probably should stay away to be safe, but your curiosity begs you to check it out.

slippedonarock.intro: Suddenly, you lose the ground under your paws, slipping on a rock and falling to the side. It hurts a little, but you aren't seriously injured.

softground.intro: The ground is soft under your paws here, and your paws itch to dig in it.

deepmud.intro: At first, the ground is just wet and slippery, but as you walk further, you find yourself in deep mud. The mud slows you down, but you take some odd pleasure in splashing it around.

drycrumblingground.intro: The ground under your paws is so dry that it crumbles under your weight, raising clouds of dust. You cough a little and decide to take a closer look at your footsteps. You're almost certain that you feel something unusual.

ammonitebed.intro: One side of a huge, dark rock slab is completely smooth, but the other side looks like the bottom of the sea, with lots of shells of different sizes still stuck within it. You can tell they're older than any wolf can remember.

ammonitefossil.intro: The beautiful, large, fossilized spiral shape is impossible to be mistaken for anything else. It's a perfectly preserved ammonite. Beautiful! Perhaps you can take it with you.

ancientfossils.intro: Various shapes of plants and small animals are pressed into this rock. You don't recognize any of them. This rock has survived for thousands of years so that you can admire the past.

fossilbed.intro: The ground has collapsed in places, allowing towers of stone to rise up and crumble away to reveal fossils underneath! Are you brave enough to have a look around?

fossilcliffleft.intro: A cliff rises to your left with fossils peeking out from a layer of rock. Maybe you should check it out!

fossilcliffright.intro: A cliff rises to your right with a column of...something crumbling from where it's embedded in the rock. Is it some sort of old human structure?

fossilcliffsplit.intro: This cliff used to be a solid wall of rock, but now it has split and revealed numerous fossils from millions of years ago. What a find! How many are there? It will take ages to look through them all. The sight is fascinating and daunting at the same time.

fossilrelief.intro: These ancient creatures were trapped in this rock for a long time, leaving their shapes imprinted forever. The rock is cracked in many places, making you wonder how much longer it will hold its form.

fossilsandstone.intro: The fossilized bones are deeply embedded in the rock, but their shapes are clearly visible. There must be a way to take them out; perhaps even all of them.

fossilslabs.intro: Perfectly visible against the light surface, the fossils embedded in the rock slabs looked easy to take out, tempting you to try.

fossilwall.intro: This wall towers so high that you can't see the top, and is absolutely riddled with bones and fossils of various sizes and shapes. Who knew so many things lurked just beneath your pawsteps that are only now coming to the surface?

fossilizedtree.intro: From a distance, the remains of the broken tree look ordinary. Upon coming closer, you realize that you don't recognize the type of tree. Its fossilized bark feels strange to the touch.

fossilizedtrunk.intro: The tree in front of you is much older than the forest around it and its scent is slightly different. Its dark bark is as hard as stone, yet it seems fragile, as if it could turn to dust at any moment.

landsliderocks.intro: Rocks have tumbled down the mountain here recently, and look quite strange compared to the plain rocks you normally see. They have strange impressions in them, almost as if there were beings that once dwelled in them...

openfossilbed.intro: There's so many nooks and crannies to explore here! Watch your pawsteps young wolf, you never know what lies beneath the ground.

raisedfossilcliff.intro: Are those...trees in that rock? You move closer, giving the rock a curious sniff. It looks like ferns were pressed into this rock years ago and have left only their imprint behind. How cool!

trilobitedeposit.intro: You almost missed it. A trilobite fossil shape is hidden in the rocky texture, but once you spot it, it's clear and impossible to mistake for anything else.
